title: Miracle Girls - Toys Bridge
description:
C3 2023 WINTER SUBMISSION

A toy-esque / card themed background seen in the obscure Miracle Girls. You may recognize it from The Second Reality Project Reloaded. This version was ripped directly from the game. The original background uses constant moving parallaxing in the water portion. I plan to rip the foreground of Toys Bridge in a near future.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
